hypothesis: Frozen E004's local TKE deficit is either a systematic spatial high-frequency underprediction in temporal fluctuations, which would justify exactly one train-scaled binned log-spectrum auxiliary, or a non-spectral temporal mean/fluctuation amplitude/phase error, which would instead justify the identity-initialized dual-head mean/fluctuation decoder. The diagnostic may support neither.
comparator: Frozen E004 packed FNO only; no retraining, blending, TTT, interval change, validation, complementary-fold evaluation, package, or submission.

training_side_split.loader: Read one released trajectory at a time, form only contiguous stride-20 windows from it, and batch those windows; this preserves trajectory membership without retaining the full train release in RAM.
training_side_split.selection_note: Exactly reuse E006/E018's trajectory-disjoint train-only calibration Re set; audit is every remaining real_regime_v1/train trajectory.

diagnostic.physical_space: u/v postprocessed using the official real mean/std; pressure is excluded
diagnostic.temporal_decomposition: For error e=pred-target, report sum(e^2)=T*sum(mean_t(e)^2)+sum((e-mean_t(e))^2), separately full-domain/wake and u/v.
diagnostic.official_tke: Organizer TKE map = 0.5*(var_t(u)+var_t(v)); energy ratio is sum(map_pred)/sum(map_target), amplitude ratio is ||map_pred||_2/||map_target||_2.

wake_region.note: The rectangle is the unambiguous bounding region of the official 32x64 MVPE probe coordinates y=8,10,...,24 and x=13,21,29,37; it is used for temporal/TKE-map breakdowns only, not a windowed wake FFT.

spatial_spectrum.field: temporal fluctuations u'=u-mean_t(u), v'=v-mean_t(v), full 32x64 domain
spatial_spectrum.transform: numpy rfft2 over H/W; raw coefficient |F|^2 is Hermitian-weighted then divided by (H*W)^2, so summed energy equals mean_{t,h,w}(u'^2) or mean_{t,h,w}(v'^2)
spatial_spectrum.zero_mode: Retain in fine radial bins and report separately, but exclude from named low/mid/high comparisons.
spatial_spectrum.per_window_log_error: RMSE over u/v and the 12 binned log energies log(E+epsilon).

route_selection.priority: Select spectral_auxiliary only when every spectral gate passes; otherwise select dual_head only when at least one dual-head condition passes; otherwise select neither. Thresholds are fixed before output and never tuned after inspection.

spectral_auxiliary.scope: combined u/v, full-domain named spectrum bands
spectral_auxiliary.criterion: Both partitions must have high-band pred/target <= 0.90, low-band ratio minus high-band ratio >= 0.10, and positive Spearman(per-window official TKE Rel-L2, per-window binned-log-spectrum RMSE) >= 0.25. Pearson is reported but not a route gate.

dual_head.criterion: If the spectral route fails, select dual_head when centered temporal fluctuation SSE share is >=0.60 on both partitions OR the full-domain combined TKE-map amplitude ratio is <=0.90 on both partitions OR >=1.10 on both partitions. The latter must retain its direction across both partitions.

route_selection.neither: If neither locked route condition holds, do not train a spectrum auxiliary or a dual-head decoder from E019 evidence.
